messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: metering.ingest consumer lag detected (consumer-group=metering-ingest-group) > 500,000 msgs. Symptoms: delayed usage reports, provisional overage flags. Severity=P1. See https://internal.redwood/status/INC-1942004321

Ava M: Picking this up — oncall. I'll gather context and coordinate mitigation.

Samir K: @Ava M I'm awake, can help with Kafka and pods. What cluster/namespace?

Ava M: prod-cluster / ns=redwood-metering. First-run checks: consumer lag, pod restarts, sidecar logs.

Jia L: I'm seeing billing pipeline alerts too. Billing team is pausing auto-charge workflows until we have clarity.

Priya R: Support: a few customers reported 'no usage shown' in dashboard. Holding outbound billing alerts.

Ava M: Quick consumer status (from control plane):
```
# kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group metering-ingest-group
TOPIC                PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG     CONSUMER-ID
metering.ingest      0          123456789       123987650       530861  metering-0
metering.ingest      1          223456789       223987650       530861  metering-1
... total lag ~520,400 msgs
```
Estimated tokens ~2.3M (~450k requests).

Samir K: Backlog confirms. Attempting quick scale + restart of ingest deployment.

Samir K: running: `kubectl -n redwood-metering scale deployment metering-ingest --replicas=8`

ops-bot: action recorded: scaled metering-ingest -> replicas=8 by Samir K

Ava M: Starting a temporary backfill worker that consumes archived topic 'metering.ingest.retry' with aggressive commit strategy. Also enabling fast-drain: `max.poll.records=5000`.

Samir K: One pod OOMKilled during restart. Logs:
```
OOMKilled: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
at ...
```
Lowering batch size on that replica: `max.poll.records=2000` and restarting.

Jia L: Adjusting JVM options on sidecar: -Xmx=2g -> -Xmx1.5g for stability. Also trimming in-memory payload cache.

billing-bot: Suppressing automated overage alerts for affected accounts until backlog < 10k messages. Marked 5 accounts as 'review' to prevent auto-charges.

Priya R: Customer impact summary (initial): 32 customers with dashboard delay >30m, 5 customers received provisional overage flags (no invoices yet). We'll prepare messaging if >60m.

Ava M: Current mitigation status: consumers scaled to 8, backfill worker active, batch size tuned. Measured drain rate ~35-45k msgs/min.

ops-bot: Status update: backlog reduced to ~110k msgs. Backfill progress steady. ETA to clear ~25 minutes.

Samir K: I'll own monitoring for the next shift. Handoff: Ava -> Samir at 16:30 UTC. I will keep alerting on consumer lag and OOMs.

Ava M: Thanks — documented actions in the incident ticket. I'll coordinate support notifications if customers escalate.

Jia L: I'll open postmortem ticket INC-1942004321 and add initial notes (root cause suspects: consumer GC / batch sizing + sudden reprocessing spike).

Priya R: Please keep billing suppressions for at least 60 more minutes. I'll follow up with support on messaging.

ops-bot: Update: backlog drained to <5k msgs, consumer replicas stable at 8, no new OOMs reported.

Samir K: Confirming. Observed final drain and healthy offsets. Reverting `max.poll.records` to production default gradually.

billing-bot: Re-enabling overage alerting for non-affected accounts. Reviewing 'review' flags before releasing holds.

Ava M: Closing active pager in 10m if no regressions. Good job team.

ops-bot: Pager closed at 1942005899. Incident severity downgraded to P3; follow-up postmortem scheduled.

Samir K: Taking post-incident actions: watchlist for 24h, add circuit-breaker to prevent large backfills from hogging memory.

Ava M: Handoff complete. Leaving notes and runbook updates in the incident doc.
